def main(input_file, output_file)
  input_lines = File.readlines(input_file)
  word_count = 0
  line_count = input_lines.length

  input_lines.each do |line|
    words = line.split
    word_count += words.length
  end

  puts "Lines: #{line_count}, Words: #{word_count}"
end

def stats(input_file, output_file)
  input_lines = File.readlines(input_file)
  line_count = input_lines.length
  word_count = input_lines.map { |line| line.split.length }.sum

  puts "Lines: #{line_count}, Words: #{word_count}"
end

if __FILE__ == $0
  main(ARGV[0], ARGV[1])
end
